title: Changelog
description: All notable changes to Zenith Companion will be documented in this file. Updates are organized chronologically by release date.

items.title: Scenic Character Spotlight with Membership Styling (`/`)
items.description: Rebuilt `/` around a borderless character showcase over your IdleMMO background vista with gold gradient membership names and badge icons, equipped pet sprites scaled proportionally beside your hero, Gear/Pets/Museum quick counts, and a compact aligned **Top Gold Routes** leaderboard.
items.raw: - **Scenic Character Spotlight with Membership Styling (`/`)**: Rebuilt `/` around a borderless character showcase over your IdleMMO background vista with gold gradient membership names and badge icons, equipped pet sprites scaled proportionally beside your hero, Gear/Pets/Museum quick counts, and a compact aligned **Top Gold Routes** leaderboard.

items.title: Rotating Zone Weather & Scenic World Boss
items.description: Paired **World Boss** countdowns with native location backgrounds and hovering boss sprites, alongside a **Current Weather** card that rotates smoothly from **Bluebell Hollow** through **The Citadel** with live weather animations, zone artwork, and active buffs.
items.raw: - **Rotating Zone Weather & Scenic World Boss**: Paired **World Boss** countdowns with native location backgrounds and hovering boss sprites, alongside a **Current Weather** card that rotates smoothly from **Bluebell Hollow** through **The Citadel** with live weather animations, zone artwork, and active buffs.

items.title: Interactive 404 Route Finder & Error Recovery
items.description: Rebuilt the Not Found, Error, and Loading pages with closest-match URL suggestions, live route and item search, a copyable error reference code, and one-click recovery options that keep saved profiles and crafting queues intact.
items.raw: - **Interactive 404 Route Finder & Error Recovery**: Rebuilt the Not Found, Error, and Loading pages with closest-match URL suggestions, live route and item search, a copyable error reference code, and one-click recovery options that keep saved profiles and crafting queues intact.

items.title: Custom Contextual Icons
items.description: Added bespoke icons across navigation, equipment slots, crafting tools, and feature headers so items and sections use clearer visual symbols.
items.raw: - **Custom Contextual Icons**: Added bespoke icons across navigation, equipment slots, crafting tools, and feature headers so items and sections use clearer visual symbols.

items.title: Refined Interface Audio & Tactile Haptics
items.description: Replaced generic legacy audio files (and removed unused background music bloat) with a compact Web Audio micro-earcon sprite and toast/action vibration patterns on supported mobile devices.
items.raw: - **Refined Interface Audio & Tactile Haptics**: Replaced generic legacy audio files (and removed unused background music bloat) with a compact Web Audio micro-earcon sprite and toast/action vibration patterns on supported mobile devices.

items.title: Faster Loading & Lighter Data Usage
items.description: Streamlined page styles and item data loading across the site so pages and item popups open quicker while using less mobile data.
items.raw: - **Faster Loading & Lighter Data Usage**: Streamlined page styles and item data loading across the site so pages and item popups open quicker while using less mobile data.

items.title: More Frequent Live Data Refreshes
items.description: Accelerated Conquest, Market Price, and active Guild refreshes alongside automated catalog checks for newly added IdleMMO items.
items.raw: - **More Frequent Live Data Refreshes**: Accelerated Conquest, Market Price, and active Guild refreshes alongside automated catalog checks for newly added IdleMMO items.

items.title: Zero Shell Redundancy & Plain Labels
items.description: Removed duplicate profile dropdowns, filter tabs, vague weather counts, `Idle cap` text, and the blocking first-run setup popup in favor of simpler headings (**Top Gold Routes**, **World Boss**, **Current Weather**, **Market Movers**, **Gear & Tools**, **Recent & Notes**).
items.raw: - **Zero Shell Redundancy & Plain Labels**: Removed duplicate profile dropdowns, filter tabs, vague weather counts, `Idle cap` text, and the blocking first-run setup popup in favor of simpler headings (**Top Gold Routes**, **World Boss**, **Current Weather**, **Market Movers**, **Gear & Tools**, **Recent & Notes**).

items.title: Forge Planner Dashboard Count (`/`)
items.description: Fixed the Home Dashboard showing `0 crafts` when your active character has saved craft plans in Forge Crafting.
items.raw: - **Forge Planner Dashboard Count (`/`)**: Fixed the Home Dashboard showing `0 crafts` when your active character has saved craft plans in Forge Crafting.

items.title: Dashboard Quick-Filter Links (`/items`, `/alchemy`, `/skill-profit`)
items.description: Fixed clicking items or recipes from **Top Gold Routes** and **Market Movers** on `/` so Items Directory, Alchemy Profit, and Skill Profit now pre-fill the search box and filter straight to your selection.
items.raw: - **Dashboard Quick-Filter Links (`/items`, `/alchemy`, `/skill-profit`)**: Fixed clicking items or recipes from **Top Gold Routes** and **Market Movers** on `/` so Items Directory, Alchemy Profit, and Skill Profit now pre-fill the search box and filter straight to your selection.

items.title: Site-Wide Contrast, Touch Targets & Layout Stability
items.description: Enlarged mobile stepper and toolbar controls for easier tapping, improved badge contrast in World Boss routines, stabilized initial loading skeletons across calculators, and cleaned up inline stat separators.
items.raw: - **Site-Wide Contrast, Touch Targets & Layout Stability**: Enlarged mobile stepper and toolbar controls for easier tapping, improved badge contrast in World Boss routines, stabilized initial loading skeletons across calculators, and cleaned up inline stat separators.

items.title: Best-in-Slot Gear Table & Next Upgrades (`/bis`)
items.description: Rebuilt `/bis` around a scannable 9-slot **Gear Table** (**Sword**, **Dagger**, **Bow**, **Shield**, **Helmet**, **Chestplate**, **Gauntlets**, **Greaves**, **Boots**) showing `Cost`, individual combat stats (`Agi`, `Acc`, `AP` / `Prot`, `Crit %`, and flat `Crit Dmg`), `Total`, `Gold / Stat`, quality BiS rank badges, and level requirements across **T1 Base**, **Optimal Tier**, and **Max Tier** scaling for all **306** combat items, paired with a 1-row-per-slot **Next Upgrades** planner, toggleable Equip/Unequip actions, click-to-inspect upgrade stone modal, and a What-If **Loadout Setup** drawer.
items.raw: - **Best-in-Slot Gear Table & Next Upgrades (`/bis`)**: Rebuilt `/bis` around a scannable 9-slot **Gear Table** (**Sword**, **Dagger**, **Bow**, **Shield**, **Helmet**, **Chestplate**, **Gauntlets**, **Greaves**, **Boots**) showing `Cost`, individual combat stats (`Agi`, `Acc`, `AP` / `Prot`, `Crit %`, and flat `Crit Dmg`), `Total`, `Gold / Stat`, quality BiS rank badges, and level requirements across **T1 Base**, **Optimal Tier**, and **Max Tier** scaling for all **306** combat items, paired with a 1-row-per-slot **Next Upgrades** planner, toggleable Equip/Unequip actions, click-to-inspect upgrade stone modal, and a What-If **Loadout Setup** drawer.

items.title: Direct In-Game Market Shortcut
items.description: Added a one-click **Buy on Market** (for tradeable items) or **Inspect in Game** button inside **Item Details** opening the item's live `web.idle-mmo.com/item/inspect/...` page directly.
items.raw: - **Direct In-Game Market Shortcut**: Added a one-click **Buy on Market** (for tradeable items) or **Inspect in Game** button inside **Item Details** opening the item's live `web.idle-mmo.com/item/inspect/...` page directly.

items.title: Crafting Cart Shopping List & Cost Breakdown
items.description: Focused **Crafting Cart** (`/crafting`) on repeatable Lv 1–89 Alchemy recipes as a recipe shopping cart showing total gold needed, estimated return and net profit (synced with Membership tax and Bartering), interactive In-Bank checkboxes that subtract owned supplies, and one-click **Copy List**.

items.title: Alchemy Loadout, EXP & Cart Integration

items.title: Minimal Crafting Cart Layout

items.title: Alchemy Profit Redesign

items.title: Forge Planner Redesign

items.title: Critical Stats Clarity & Equipment Pricing (`/bis`)
items.description: Split weapon `Crit` into clear **`Crit %`** and flat **`Crit Dmg`** columns without false `%` suffixes on flat bonus crit damage, prevented equipping the same gear piece twice, and replaced misleading `Vendor sell` labels on Mythic and unlisted gear with `No market listings`.

items.title: Inline Button Icon Spacing
items.description: Added clean spacing between inline icons and labels across action buttons so text never sits flush against leading icons.
items.raw: - **Inline Button Icon Spacing**: Added clean spacing between inline icons and labels across action buttons so text never sits flush against leading icons.

items.title: Best-in-Slot Missing Forge Gear & Dual Daggers
items.description: Restored all **81** crafted metal armour/weapon and wooden bow recipes to `/bis` (bringing the catalog from 225 to all **306** combat items, including `Dreadbane Armour` and `Soulguard Armour`), read profile Combat, Strength, Dexterity, and Defence levels accurately, and added **Dual Daggers** main/offhand slot comparisons.
items.raw: - **Best-in-Slot Missing Forge Gear & Dual Daggers**: Restored all **81** crafted metal armour/weapon and wooden bow recipes to `/bis` (bringing the catalog from 225 to all **306** combat items, including `Dreadbane Armour` and `Soulguard Armour`), read profile Combat, Strength, Dexterity, and Defence levels accurately, and added **Dual Daggers** main/offhand slot comparisons.

items.title: Items Directory Tradeable Filter & Initial Loading Shift
items.description: Kept tradeable items without recent market sales (including `Bunny Ears` and 107 other tradeable items) visible under **Tradeable only** on `/items`, while stabilizing initial loading skeletons across desktop and mobile viewports.

items.title: Crafting Cart Purchase Pricing & Picker Alignment
items.description: Stopped falling back to NPC sell values as market buy prices on unpriced Crafting Cart materials (while keeping NPC vial prices accurate), excluded starter guest profiles from Bartering lookup, fixed the recipe picker reopening over **Add to Cart** after selecting a recipe, and aligned picker, stepper, and button heights.

items.title: Mythic Craft Speed, Class Bonuses & Contrast
items.description: Fixed Mythic Lab using a pre-reduced base duration (`1500s` / `25m` before Membership and efficiency bonuses instead of `1363.6s`), included Alchemist, Ascension, and Pool buffs, excluded starter guest profiles from synced loadouts, removed initial sync banner layout shifts, and improved active sidebar level badge contrast.

items.title: Alchemy Break-Even Math & Forge Dropdowns
items.description: Fixed ingredient break-even prices using crafting return rather than raw liquidation value on "Sell inputs" routes, kept Cursed and Forsaken EXP penalties accurate, fixed Forge recipe dropdown transparency, and stopped Forge material rows from shifting during profile hydration.
